newsitem.title: USA: HS to sell property to Gothic Energy.
newsitem.headline: HS to sell property to Gothic Energy.

text.p: HS Resources Inc said Tuesday it agreed to sell certain non-core properties in Oklahoma and New Mexico to Gothic Energy Corp for $24.4 million cash.
In addition, HS will receive title to other producing Arkoma Basin properties near the existing assets.
HS will use proceeds from the sale to repay bank debt.
The company said it will have outstanding bank debt of about $129 million after using the proceeds of the sale.
The company said it expects additional sales of non-strategic, non-core assets in its ongoing effort to raise shareholder value.
The company reported $174 million in debt at year end 1996 and $139 million as of March 31.
The deal is effective as of July 1, and HS said it it expects the deal to close no later than August 28.
The properties to be sold include 150 wells in the Anadarko basin of western Oklahoma and 101 wells in southeast New Mexico.
During 1996, these properties generated $4.0 million of operating cash flow. Net daily production is 5.5 million cubic feet of gas and 208 barrels of oil.
